text:
Elaine K: Quick ping — dropping the compact 'snapshot peek' mock in the thread. goal: make version-history denser on mobile while keeping rollback discoverable. https://img.redwood.test/snap-peek.png Marco R: Nice. My first thought: the panic affordance (rollback) gets visually lost when we compress. we should keep a persistent outline or a sticky pill. Sophie L: Agree on persistence. Maybe the rollback becomes a left-aligned compact pill with an outlined danger color, and the commit meta collapses into a single line. Jordan T: Concern: keyboard users need a clear tab stop for the rollback action. If it's collapsed into the timeline item, it might be skipped. we must keep an accessible focus order. Elaine K: Good call. Proposal: keep rollback as the last focusable control in each snapshot and add an aria-describedby that references the snapshot timestamp + change reason. Marco R: Visual idea: when you long-press or hover the snapshot, show a thin preview strip that includes three actions: preview, diff, rollback. on mobile it becomes a bottom-sheet. Sophie L: Mobile bottom-sheet feels right. But we need to avoid duplicate CTAs — the timeline item should still be tappable to open details, not trigger rollback by accident. microcopy needs to be explicit. e.g., 'Rollback to v3 · 2 days ago' rather than just 'Rollback'. Jordan T: +1 to explicit copy. Also request: add an aria-live polite region for the rollback success/failure message so screenreader users get clear feedback. DesignBot: Snapshot peek PATTERN added to Figma: https://figma.redwood.test/file/abcd1234. Annotated keyboard flow and aria notes. Elaine K: For the a11y snippet, how does this look? Elaine K: ```html Commit: 7f9a2b — hotfix — 2 days ago
``` Marco R: That looks good. Consider replacing hidden span with offscreen text (CSS .sr-only) so it's announced on focus reliably. Sophie L: Microcopy tweak: instead of 'Rollback to snapshot...' try 'Revert to version 7f9a2b (hotfix) — this will reroute traffic'. Short but informative. Jordan T: Also add role="alert" to critical failures so they are announced immediately. But only use it for true errors, keep success as polite. Elaine K: UX nit: animation when snapshots expand — keep it subtle. avoid layout shift that bumps nearby timeline items (especially on slow devices). Marco R: Performance nit: if we animate height, use transform on the inner content and absolute positioning to avoid reflow. Sophie L: Copy decision: 'Preview' vs 'Inspect' — prefer 'Inspect' for the diff view (less ambiguous). Jordan T: Accessibility checklist request: make sure focus trap in the bottom-sheet includes 'Inspect' and 'Rollback' and a clear 'Close' control labeled 'Close snapshot details'. Elaine K: Next steps: Marco to update figma with persistent pill + focus order; Sophie to author final microcopy options; Jordan to add aria/keyboard acceptance criteria; I'll review and ship to frontend for a quick prototype. Marco R: On it — will post updated frames by EOD. :thumbsup: Sophie L: I'll draft the microcopy choices and post variants. Jordan T: I'll draft acceptance criteria as a short checklist. DesignBot: Reminder: design review in #design next Tue at 10am PT for final sign-off. Elaine K: Thanks everyone — keeping the compact timeline while preserving discoverability and keyboard flow is the win here.
